profile.name: Mihir Patel
profile.heroDescription: I build software, train models, and tinker with AI systems. Currently exploring the space between solid engineering and intelligent products.

about.heading: Curious by default, builder by habit.
paragraphs: I'm Mihir — a recent graduate from Ahmedabad, India. I love sitting at the intersection of software, machine learning and AI, where ideas turn into working systems you can poke at and improve.

focus.title: Software Engineering
focus.desc: Full-stack web apps with TypeScript, React and Python backends.

focus.title: ML Engineering
focus.desc: Training, evaluating and shipping models with PyTorch and scikit-learn.

focus.title: AI Engineering
focus.desc: LLM apps, RAG pipelines and agents using LangChain and open models.

projects.title: GitDecode
projects.desc: AI-powered codebase intelligence platform replacing vector chunking with Vectorless RAG via AST graph traversal. Features multi-agent LangGraph workflows, interactive Neo4j NVL graph visualizer, and 3-hop blast radius analysis.
projects.tag: AI · Python · LangGraph · Neo4j · Vectorless RAG

projects.title: The Daily Intelligence
projects.desc: AI-synthesized global and Indian news aggregator that clusters events using LangGraph, provides automated daily briefings, and features an interactive RAG chat for grounded queries.

projects.title: Movie Recommender System
projects.desc: Content-based movie recommendation engine built with Python and Streamlit. Uses cosine similarity on movie metadata to suggest similar films, containerised with Docker for easy deployment.

projects.title: AgenticPilot
projects.desc: AI-powered SaaS platform that uses autonomous agents to automate business operations — from Gmail triage to social media workflows — built with Next.js 15 and Google Gemini.

projects.title: Exoplanet Detection
projects.desc: Machine learning pipeline to detect exoplanets from Kepler light-curve data using ensemble methods, SMOTE resampling and cross-validated model comparison for robust classification.

contact.heading: Let's build something.
contact.description: I'm actively looking for my first role and open to collaborations on interesting software, ML or AI projects. The fastest way to reach me is email — I reply to everything.
